title: Why Did the Dinosaurs Disappear? The Real Story of the Extinction
description:
Sixty-six million years ago, the dinosaurs vanished. A layer of iridium-rich clay, a buried crater in Mexico, an impact winter, giant volcanoes in India… and a twist: not every dinosaur died. Here is the real story, step by step.
